recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12067 unless Financial Management opens a new issue to revise the beneficiary/subscriber/policyHolder model.
issue_request: FHIR-12067 asked to rename the Coverage PlanBenificary/beneficiary concept to Patient. The final Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: retain beneficiary, rename PlanHolder to Subscriber, and add PolicyHolder 0..1 Reference(Patient|RelatedPerson|Organization) for the party that owns the policy.
